## Ctx.classifySendError() method

Classify a send failure as `fallback-text` (content rejected, reply with fallback text) or `retryable` (rate limit, server, network, or unknown — rethrow the original error untouched, fail-loud default).

**Signature:**

```typescript
static classifySendError(err: unknown): `fallback-text` | `retryable`;
```

## Remarks

Mapping: `GrammyError 429` → `retryable 400–499 (incl. 403)`<!-- -->; → `fallback-text >= 500`<!-- -->; → `retryable`<!-- -->; `HttpError`<!-- -->/network and anything unknown → `retryable`<!-- -->.
